name: R20 the page behaves like a game on a phone
description: viewport meta plus touch-action and user-select on the touch surface, so iOS stops selecting and zooming the canvas; verified on an iPhone SE viewport by tools/test-shell.mjs. Ceiling is on the GATE's basis (--O1, randomised roadroller search, 15-iteration zopfli), whose spread is ~70 bytes; the submission basis (strands:ship, --O2, 200 iterations) is what the 13,312 limit applies to and stands at 13,234.
